thread:
sam: Heads up — invoice-preview shows ~0.6% extra tokens for a small set of tenants after the per-route sampling canary. I traced it to a handful of billing-events missing `charge_origin`. We need to pick where to derive it: edge enrich vs aggregator compute.
anya: Can you paste an example event? If it's consistently missing at the source we should fix the producer. If it's present but transformed, aggregator might be safer.
kevin: paste: ```{\n  \"event_type\": \"usage\",\n  \"tenant_id\": \"t-123\",\n  \"tokens\": 412,\n  \"route\": \"chat-stream\"\n}``` no `charge_origin`.
marta: The console invoice-preview is already confusing product because preview != final. If we change derivation location it will affect diffs. Ops wants minimal change for hotfix.
sam: Right. Options: A) add `charge_origin` at edge proxy (fast, fixes preview and final), B) compute in aggregator during enrichment (centralized, easier to reason about for historical backfills), C) add a reconciliation step to normalize both (more work).
kevin: Edge adding is tempting but edge has partial visibility into routing fallback (we sometimes re-route at infra layer). Deriving there risks mismatches when the runtime rewrites route metadata.
anya: Good point. Do we have the routing-decisions stream attached to edge? If we can attach the same decision fingerprint we could be consistent.
marta: From a rollout UX POV, if we do aggregator compute we can version the rule and roll it with A/B. Console can show a flag: preview-mode uses v1, final uses v2 until rollout complete.
sam: Can we do a quick patch on the edge to copy existing `route_reason` -> `charge_origin` when present, and fall back to `unknown`? That would be a fast stopgap without full logic.
oncall-bot: @sam created incident INC-9452 for invoice-delta spike. Assigned to @kevin and @anya.
ingest-bot: ERROR: enrichment-service failed to find `charge_origin` for event t-123 batch=2026-03-20T12:02Z. Count=47.
kevin: I'll open a PR that 1) adds edge copy fallback (hotfix), 2) adds aggregator rule with feature flag and deterministic precedence. Then we can run a small backfill for affected hour windows.
anya: Also add a console annotation for affected tenants so CS can proactively notify. The preview/final delta needs an explain link.
marta: +1 on the explain link. Also log the version used to derive `charge_origin` in invoice-preview so customers and us can correlate.
sam: OK action list: kevin -> edge hotfix PR + aggregator flag PR, anya -> console annotation + preview logging, marta -> coordinate CS messaging and rollouts page. I'll monitor INC-9452 and recheck invoice-preview after hotfix.
kevin: Will do. ETA for hotfix: ~3h. Will post PR link here.
sam: thx. :thumbsup
